title: A lower-case number with a hyphen, tabbed out fast, still shows the inactive message
custom_steps:
1. Estimate → Add Part
  2. Type P1 in lower case with a hyphen (abc-123) and press Tab at once
  3. Wait a moment
custom_expected:
1. Part dialog opens
  2. No part is picked
  3. The field shows "{P1 stocked number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."
